mechanism.couple.summary: Evaluate a mechanism coupling (signed rotational ratio or screw lead plus zero phase) into an explicit unwrapped track; angles may exceed 360 degrees. Does not create or infer a native MotionLink.

inputs.coupling: Coupling descriptor {type:rotation|screw, ratio? or driverTeeth/drivenTeeth/external?, lead?, zeroPhase?, drivenZero?}. rotation: signed ratio or gear teeth (external flips sign). screw: lead length per revolution.
inputs.driverRange: Required {from,to} angle expressions for the evaluated driver track; may span more than 360 deg.
inputs.drivenMeasured: Optional array of driven values, one per sample, to compute residuals.
inputs.tolerance: Optional coupling tolerance (angle for rotation, length for screw).
inputs.representation: explicit (default); native is refused because this operation only evaluates mathematics. Use mechanism.motion-link.create for native authoring.

limitations: Gear ratio and screw lead are distinct relationships; a disconnected follower is independent and engagement is never assumed.
This operation returns mathematical expectations only; it never creates or infers a native MotionLink.

mechanism.inspect.summary: Inspect a coupling against actual driver/driven values and report the residual and engagement.

inputs.drivenValue: Actual driven value (angle for rotation, length for screw).

limitations: Actual values are caller-supplied; read joint values through joint.inspect and pass them in for a full native check.

mechanism.stop-check.summary: Check mechanism stops: program limit versus physical stop, engagement through the hard stop, stop-surface margins and sensor window placement.

inputs.stopSurfaces: Optional array of {ref?, clearance} physical stop evidence.
inputs.engagement: Optional engagement descriptor; a mechanical counter keeps engagement through the hard stop.
inputs.tolerance: Optional coupling tolerance (angle for rotation, length for screw), default 0.01.
inputs.lengthTolerance: Optional length tolerance for stop-surface margins, default 0 mm.
inputs.driverValue: Optional driver value at the hard stop.
inputs.drivenValue: Optional driven value at the hard stop.

limitations: Program limit is a distinct limit, never a substitute for a physical stop; missing declared limits are unknown, not pass.

mechanism.motion-link.create.summary: Create and read back a real revolute-to-revolute MotionLink between explicitly referenced native joints; this mutation does not qualify solver behavior.

inputs.confirm: Required true; this operation creates and modifies a native MotionLink in the exact pinned document.
inputs.jointOne: Exact unsuppressed native Joint/AsBuiltJoint reference; must expose revolute rotation motion and belong to the pinned design.
inputs.jointTwo: A distinct exact unsuppressed native Joint/AsBuiltJoint reference; must expose revolute rotation motion and belong to the pinned design.
inputs.valueOne: Required positive finite angle expression for MotionLinkInput.valueOne.
inputs.valueTwo: Required positive finite angle expression for MotionLinkInput.valueTwo.
inputs.isReversed: Optional strict boolean, default false, passed to the native MotionLinkInput.

limitations: Uses Autodesk's documented MotionLinks.createInput/add API. Only native revolute-to-revolute links are supported by this operation.
Does not move joints or occurrences, set followers, calculate a ratio/phase, or claim actual solver behavior. Run mechanism.drive-test separately against the created link.
Creation is a model mutation and is not rolled back if post-create readback fails. Do not blindly retry an uncertain result; inspect the pinned document first.

mechanism.drive-test.summary: Measure follower response while driving only one native driver over bounded waypoints; mathematical tracks are expectations, not solver or native-capability proof.

inputs.confirm: Required true; this operation commands the driver joint and requires explicit confirmation.
inputs.driver: Existing native rotational Joint/AsBuiltJoint reference. It is the only joint that may be commanded.
inputs.waypoints: Required 2..240 absolute driver angles in radians. Adjacent steps must be < pi/2; the captured starting angle must be near the first point. The driver and expected follower excursions must exceed their tolerances.
inputs.followers: Required 1..32 distinct unsuppressed Joint/AsBuiltJoint observations [{joint,coordinate:rotation|slide,ratio,phase,tolerance}]. Rotation is radians with ratio rad/rad; slide is cm with ratio cm/rad. Followers are read only and never set to expected values.
inputs.budgetSeconds: Optional cooperative sampling budget, default 10 and maximum 30 seconds. Synchronous SDK work cannot be hard-interrupted; cleanup has a separate bounded operation count.
inputs.driverTolerance: Optional positive radian tolerance, default 1e-7 and maximum 0.01.
inputs.restoreTolerance: Optional positive tolerance for pose readback, default 1e-7 and maximum 0.001 (native units).

limitations: The commanded mathematical track, sampled actual joint/transform readback, and native capability are separate evidence. Passing samples do not qualify a native MotionLink or solver relationship; nativeCapability remains unknown and qualified:false.
Only the driver is commanded, including restore. Followers and transforms are observed only. Capture is independently read back after the restore attempt; failure or unavailable readback is explicit.
Angular phase is locally unwrapped from consecutive measured values, never fitted to expected phase. Whole turns aliased between samples cannot be detected; increments at or above pi/2 are rejected.

Sampling is bounded and kinematic only; it does not prove continuous motion, contact, collision, dynamics, or physical performance. Cancellation is cooperative; synchronous native calls cannot be remotely interrupted.
Offline fake-solver tests are not native Fusion qualification. Real positive/negative synthetic-document tests and restore-failure qualification require separate explicit approval.
